title: Lombok configuration properties
description: JSON representation of known Lombok configuration properties. This schema does not validate the line-based lombok.config file format.

config.stopBubbling.title: config.stopBubbling
config.stopBubbling.description: Tells the configuration system not to look in parent directories for more `lombok.config` files.

lombok.addLombokGeneratedAnnotation.title: lombok.addLombokGeneratedAnnotation
lombok.addLombokGeneratedAnnotation.description: When `true`, Lombok adds `@lombok.Generated` to all generated methods, constructors, and types. This helps code coverage tools (such as JaCoCo) ignore generated code.

lombok.addJavaxGeneratedAnnotation.title: lombok.addJavaxGeneratedAnnotation
lombok.addJavaxGeneratedAnnotation.description: When `true`, Lombok adds `@javax.annotation.Generated` to generated classes.

lombok.addJakartaGeneratedAnnotation.title: lombok.addJakartaGeneratedAnnotation
lombok.addJakartaGeneratedAnnotation.description: When `true`, Lombok adds `@jakarta.annotation.Generated` to generated classes.

lombok.addNullAnnotations.title: lombok.addNullAnnotations
lombok.addNullAnnotations.description: Specifies which nullability annotations Lombok should add to generated getters, setters, and parameters.

lombok.accessors.fluent.title: lombok.accessors.fluent
lombok.accessors.fluent.description: If `true`, generated getters and setters will be fluent (e.g. `foo()` instead of `getFoo()`, and `foo(String x)` instead of `setFoo(String x)`).

lombok.accessors.chain.title: lombok.accessors.chain
lombok.accessors.chain.description: If `true`, generated setters will return `this` to allow method chaining instead of `void`.

lombok.accessors.prefix.title: lombok.accessors.prefix
lombok.accessors.prefix.description: A list of prefixes to strip from field names when generating accessors (e.g. `+= m_` or `+= f_`). Supports `+=`, `-=`, and `clear`.

lombok.accessors.capitalization.title: lombok.accessors.capitalization
lombok.accessors.capitalization.description: Controls how Lombok capitalizes field names with a single leading lower-case letter followed by an upper-case letter (e.g., `uName`). `beanspec` preserves JavaBean specification quirks.

lombok.accessors.makeFinal.title: lombok.accessors.makeFinal
lombok.accessors.makeFinal.description: If `true`, generated getters will be declared `final`.

lombok.getter.noIsPrefix.title: lombok.getter.noIsPrefix
lombok.getter.noIsPrefix.description: If `true`, boolean getters will be named `getFoo()` instead of `isFoo()`.

lombok.accessors.noIsPrefix.title: lombok.accessors.noIsPrefix
lombok.accessors.noIsPrefix.x-lombok-deprecation-message: Deprecated by Project Lombok. Use `lombok.getter.noIsPrefix` instead.

lombok.anyConstructor.suppressConstructo.title: lombok.anyConstructor.suppressConstructorProperties
lombok.anyConstructor.suppressConstructo.x-lombok-deprecation-message: Deprecated by Project Lombok. Use `lombok.anyConstructor.addConstructorProperties = false` instead.

lombok.noArgsConstructor.extraPrivate.title: lombok.noArgsConstructor.extraPrivate
lombok.noArgsConstructor.extraPrivate.description: If `true`, Lombok generates a private no-args constructor if needed by frameworks (e.g. JPA / Hibernate).

lombok.equalsAndHashCode.doNotUseGetters.title: lombok.equalsAndHashCode.doNotUseGetters
lombok.equalsAndHashCode.doNotUseGetters.description: If `true`, Lombok uses direct field access instead of calling getters inside `equals` and `hashCode` implementations.

lombok.equalsAndHashCode.callSuper.title: lombok.equalsAndHashCode.callSuper
lombok.equalsAndHashCode.callSuper.description: Determines how `equals` and `hashCode` call the superclass method when extending a non-Object class: `call`, `ignore`, or `warn`.

lombok.equalsAndHashCode.warnWhenNoExpli.title: lombok.equalsAndHashCode.warnWhenNoExplicitlyIncluded
lombok.equalsAndHashCode.warnWhenNoExpli.description: If `true`, Lombok emits a warning when `@EqualsAndHashCode(onlyExplicitlyIncluded = true)` is used without any explicit `@EqualsAndHashCode.Include` fields.

lombok.toString.doNotUseGetters.title: lombok.toString.doNotUseGetters
lombok.toString.doNotUseGetters.description: If `true`, Lombok uses direct field access instead of calling getters inside `toString` implementations.

lombok.toString.callSuper.title: lombok.toString.callSuper
lombok.toString.callSuper.description: Determines whether `toString` calls superclass `toString` if the class extends a non-Object class: `call`, `ignore`, or `warn`.

lombok.toString.includeFieldNames.title: lombok.toString.includeFieldNames
lombok.toString.includeFieldNames.description: Whether field names are included in generated `toString` representations.

lombok.toString.onlyExplicitlyIncluded.title: lombok.toString.onlyExplicitlyIncluded
lombok.toString.onlyExplicitlyIncluded.description: If `true`, only fields and methods explicitly marked with `@ToString.Include` will be included in `toString`.

lombok.builder.className.title: lombok.builder.className
lombok.builder.className.description: Pattern for generated builder class names. The asterisk `*` is replaced with the annotated class name (default: `*Builder`).

lombok.superBuilder.className.title: lombok.superBuilder.className
lombok.superBuilder.className.description: Pattern for generated SuperBuilder class names.

lombok.singular.useGuava.title: lombok.singular.useGuava
lombok.singular.useGuava.description: If `true`, Lombok uses Guava Immutable collections for `@Singular` fields instead of `java.util.Collections.unmodifiable*`.

lombok.singular.auto.title: lombok.singular.auto
lombok.singular.auto.description: If `true`, Lombok automatically discovers singular forms of plural collection field names.

lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate.title: lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate
lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate.description: If `true`, fields without explicit access modifiers will default to `private`.

lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultFinal.title: lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultFinal
lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultFinal.description: If `true`, fields without explicit `final` modifiers will default to `final`.

lombok.fieldNameConstants.prefix.title: lombok.fieldNameConstants.prefix
lombok.fieldNameConstants.prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to generated field name constants.

lombok.fieldNameConstants.suffix.title: lombok.fieldNameConstants.suffix
lombok.fieldNameConstants.suffix.description: Suffix to append to generated field name constants.

lombok.fieldNameConstants.uppercase.title: lombok.fieldNameConstants.uppercase
lombok.fieldNameConstants.uppercase.description: If `true`, generated field name constants will be uppercase snake_case.

lombok.fieldNameConstants.asEnum.title: lombok.fieldNameConstants.asEnum
lombok.fieldNameConstants.asEnum.description: If `true`, Lombok generates an `enum` instead of a static inner class of constants.

lombok.log.fieldName.title: lombok.log.fieldName
lombok.log.fieldName.description: The name of the generated logger field (e.g. `log` or `LOGGER`).

lombok.log.fieldIsStatic.title: lombok.log.fieldIsStatic
lombok.log.fieldIsStatic.description: Whether the generated logger field should be static.

lombok.nonNull.exceptionType.title: lombok.nonNull.exceptionType
lombok.nonNull.exceptionType.description: Exception type thrown when a `@NonNull` parameter is null.

lombok.nonNull.customAnnotation.title: lombok.nonNull.customAnnotation
lombok.nonNull.customAnnotation.description: Custom annotation type to use when Lombok generates null-checks (e.g. `com.example.MyNonNull`).

lombok.copyableAnnotations.title: lombok.copyableAnnotations
lombok.copyableAnnotations.description: List of annotations copied from fields onto generated getters, setters, withers, and constructors. Supports `+=`, `-=`, and `clear`.

lombok.jackson.jsonProperty.title: lombok.jackson.jsonProperty
lombok.jackson.jsonProperty.description: Whether to automatically copy `@JsonProperty` to generated builder setter methods.

lombok.extern.findbugs.addSuppressFBWarn.title: lombok.extern.findbugs.addSuppressFBWarnings
lombok.extern.findbugs.addSuppressFBWarn.description: When `true`, Lombok adds `@edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.SuppressFBWarnings` to generated code.

lombok.disableConfig.title: lombok.disableConfig
lombok.disableConfig.description: If `true`, Lombok completely stops processing any configuration files in this directory or subdirectories.

lombok.accessors.flagUsage.title: lombok.accessors.flagUsage
lombok.accessors.flagUsage.description: Configures compiler diagnostic level when using `@accessors`: `allow` (permitted), `warning` (emits compiler warning), or `error` (compilation fails).
